cases.title: Authority and channel ownership
cases.requirement: Core privacy rules remain authority; ordinary observe and native Harness logs are not audit-safe by construction.
cases.scenario: Existing observer with synthetic raw metadata
cases.expected: No persistence-safety claim and no implicit audit forwarding

cases.title: Owned egress
cases.requirement: The concrete observeAudit extension delivers only closed DshAuditEvent projections from accepted source seams; no raw RuntimeEvent/Receipt/sidecar import port.
cases.scenario: Audit subscription receives a supported source lifecycle fact
cases.expected: Exactly one profile-tagged closed projection

cases.title: Host digest isolation
cases.requirement: Audit never calls or trusts DshRc5AdapterOptions.digest, including digest-shaped canary output.
cases.scenario: Coexisting ordinary observer returns a synthetic canary digest; audit-only subscription is separately tested with a configured throwing ordinary digest
cases.expected: Audit computation remains owned; ordinary callback output never enters audit

cases.title: All nine events
cases.requirement: Each of the nine event types has only the required/optional fields in Spec 0049 section 3.
cases.scenario: One valid source fixture per event type
cases.expected: Closed immutable projections; no unexpected keys

cases.title: Raw arguments
cases.requirement: argumentsDigest covers the exact durable tool/call arguments string with the arguments/raw-string domain, without parsing it.
cases.scenario: Canary-bearing JSON text with alternative whitespace
cases.expected: No raw body; independent envelope digest matches; whitespace changes digest

cases.title: Final authority
cases.requirement: resultDigest covers the whole final materialized tools/result value after all rewrites.
cases.scenario: Real agent-backed ToolRuntime with two result rewrites and canary final payload
cases.expected: Digest matches final value, differs from earlier candidates, and no raw payload

cases.title: No digest substitution
cases.requirement: Earlier candidates, normalized events and precomputed digests cannot substitute for source result evidence.
cases.scenario: Host supplies a valid-looking sha256 value unrelated to final result
cases.expected: Never reuse or hash it as result/final-json evidence

cases.title: Failure source
cases.requirement: failureDigest covers the entire supported failure value; unsupported failures reject rather than produce a partial source digest.
cases.scenario: Supported canary-bearing pinned failure plus unsupported Error helper fixture
cases.expected: Supported complete source digest or atomic rejection; distinguish helper/runtime witnesses

cases.title: Metadata strings
cases.requirement: All tool names, optional error codes and failure classes use their distinct owned metadata domains.
cases.scenario: Synthetic canary in every free-form metadata field
cases.expected: Only owned digests; no raw name/code/class

cases.title: Identity strings
cases.requirement: Every event/session/turn/step/call/root-call/approval identity is substituted according to section 5.
cases.scenario: Synthetic canary in each source ref independently
cases.expected: No raw refs; independent identity-envelope digests

cases.title: Preserve joins
cases.requirement: Within-session request/completion/approval correlation uses the same callKey and a root call uses the call identity domain.
cases.scenario: One requested/completed/approval sequence and explicit root-call source fixture
cases.expected: Actual shared identities join; absent root identity is not invented

cases.title: Separate identity domains
cases.requirement: Different sessions and different identity domains are distinguished, without string-concatenation ambiguity.
cases.scenario: Same raw call ID across two sessions; same string as call and approval; delimiter-containing IDs
cases.expected: Distinct expected domain/session digests

cases.title: Optional correlation
cases.requirement: Optional fields remain absent when missing; required identity cannot be fabricated to salvage a fact.
cases.scenario: Approval without callId and invalid required empty session/call reference
cases.expected: First is admitted without callKey; second is rejected

cases.title: Control compatibility
cases.requirement: Policy/guard/approval raw inputs and ordinary RuntimeEvent meanings remain unchanged.
cases.scenario: Canary in arguments needed by policy alongside audit observation
cases.expected: Original control value observed and accepted enforcement/approval outcomes preserved

cases.title: Coexisting subscriptions
cases.requirement: Ordinary and multiple audit subscriptions preserve final classification without twice-consuming disposition state.
cases.scenario: Ordinary plus two audit subscribers on denied, cancelled and successful executions
cases.expected: All see consistent outcome and one final fact per subscription

cases.title: Closed enums and time
cases.requirement: Enums are runtime checked and timestamps are reconstructed, never arbitrary source text.
cases.scenario: Unknown outcome/source, malformed clock string, valid epoch time
cases.expected: Invalid facts reject; valid UTC timestamp reconstructed

cases.title: Unknown sensitive fields
cases.requirement: Bodies, environment, prompt, source, stdout/stderr, reason, stack/cause and extension properties are never forwarded.
cases.scenario: Canaries in extra source properties including nested bodies
cases.expected: Closed output keys only; required source evidence still digested exactly

cases.title: Canonical vectors
cases.requirement: Owned SHA-256 uses the documented UTF-8 JCS domain envelope, including sorted object keys and exact array order.
cases.scenario: Independent vectors plus reordered object properties
cases.expected: Expected digests match; source is not mutated

cases.title: Unicode and numeric encoding
cases.requirement: JCS preserves Unicode and ECMAScript numeric meaning; invalid Unicode and non-finite numbers reject.
cases.scenario: Non-ASCII names, control escapes, negative zero, exponent numbers, lone surrogate, NaN and Infinity
cases.expected: Independent valid vectors; invalid values rejected without coercion

cases.title: Accessor and coercion rejection
cases.requirement: Own accessors, unsupported prototypes and source toJSON/toString are not invoked to make input admissible.
cases.scenario: Throwing/canary getter, Error/Date/class instance and toJSON function
cases.expected: Atomic unsupported rejection; accessor/coercion side-effect counters remain zero

cases.title: Structural invalidity
cases.requirement: Cycles, symbols, sparse/extended arrays, undefined, bigint and functions cannot be silently omitted or converted.
cases.scenario: Each unsupported shape separately, including revoked/throwing Proxy inspection
cases.expected: Fixed unsupported diagnostic with no raw thrown payload

cases.title: Encoding limits
cases.requirement: Inclusive depth 64, values 65536 and encoded bytes 1048576 apply per D invocation with no caller override or truncation.
cases.scenario: Boundary and boundary-plus-one fixtures for each limit
cases.expected: Boundary accepted when otherwise valid; overflow rejects whole event

cases.title: Atomic projection
cases.requirement: Projection failure delivers no partially constructed record, raw fallback or misleading source digest.
cases.scenario: A later required digest fails after earlier metadata digests succeeded
cases.expected: Zero sink calls for the failed fact; rejection count increments

cases.title: Safe diagnostics
cases.requirement: Audit diagnostics are fixed codes only and never inspect/serialize caught errors or use raw onObservationFailure.
cases.scenario: Canary string/Error/hostile toString thrown at projection/hash/sink boundaries
cases.expected: No canary/raw error callback; fixed closed diagnostic and INCOMPLETE

cases.title: Ordered delivery
cases.requirement: Audit delivery is ordered per subscription without automatic retry, and later success cannot erase prior failure.
cases.scenario: Delayed accept, one rejection, then a successful fact
cases.expected: Ordered single attempts; correct delivered/failed counts; sticky INCOMPLETE

cases.title: Drain and dispose
cases.requirement: Drain covers prior capture; dispose detaches then drains and is idempotent, returning immutable safe summaries.
cases.scenario: Pending sink delivery, drain, repeated dispose and later source fact
cases.expected: Prior work settles once; no post-dispose capture; safe stable snapshots

cases.title: Capacity and counter limits
cases.requirement: Outstanding events are bounded to 1024; counters saturate safely and exhaustion stops capture with explicit inexact status.
cases.scenario: 1024 outstanding plus one; internal counter boundary fixture near MAX_SAFE_INTEGER
cases.expected: Explicit limit rejection; no wrap or silent loss; countsExact=false on saturation

cases.title: Unsupported input is not success
cases.requirement: Unsupported required source representation yields INCOMPLETE without altering execution policy or final tool success.
cases.scenario: Successful tool with an audit projection fault; separate supported normal path
cases.expected: Tool outcome preserved; failed audit not reported COMPLETE

cases.title: No replay or sidecar laundering
cases.requirement: Replay and sidecar construction remain distinct privileged channels without a new audit ingress or persistence permission.
cases.scenario: Existing replay and sidecar with opaque canary refs/digest and process-local token
cases.expected: Accepted existing correlation/token-omission contract unchanged; no automatic audit-safe forwarding

cases.title: Receipt boundary
cases.requirement: Decision/Receipt construction remains construction-only and schema validity cannot authorize persistence.
cases.scenario: Existing record constructor receives a bounded canary-bearing ref
cases.expected: No automatic persistence or audit-safety classification; Core redaction requirement remains

cases.title: Retention boundary
cases.requirement: No secrets/rawPrompt/environment opt-in, general detector or M5 ledger/storage/TTL/export capability is added.
cases.scenario: Compare dependencies, schema baselines and production entry points
cases.expected: Owning milestones and existing false retention flags unchanged

cases.title: Native raw history
cases.requirement: The profile does not redact or relabel native Harness session history and does not claim host isolation.
cases.scenario: Native canary tool/call record and its separate audit projection
cases.expected: Native history remains identified as privileged source; emitted audit is minimized

cases.title: Cryptographic trust limits
cases.requirement: Digest syntax, field omission and canary absence alone do not prove privacy; privileged host and low-entropy guessing limits are explicit.
cases.scenario: Review product-facing claims and trust premises
cases.expected: Only bounded owned-egress guarantee; no sandbox/encryption/confidentiality overclaim

cases.title: Schema and API compatibility
cases.requirement: Adapter-only audit type does not alter existing portable schemas, RuntimeEvent refs or observation subscription signatures.
cases.scenario: Compile existing ordinary consumers and new extension contract; compare schema hashes
cases.expected: Existing consumers compile unchanged; no portable persisted-record claim

cases.title: Evidence quality
cases.requirement: Every corpus case maps to executable or reviewed source evidence, and real pinned tests cannot be replaced by helper mocks.
cases.scenario: Trace DAP IDs through final tests/source witnesses and exact Harness SHA
cases.expected: No unmapped cases, fabricated runtime shapes or canary-only universal proof

cases.title: Gate sequence
cases.requirement: Protocol/TCK precedes production; final conformance, acceptance and governance require exact-head dual-green before closing M4-045.
cases.scenario: Check commit ancestry, Actions step 10/11 evidence, roadmap and Draft PR state
cases.expected: Gate remains unchecked until accepted; no M4-050/M5 implementation or merge in candidate
